b: Up there, there was all kinds of different food.. Since I'd already told them I wanted vegetarian food, that akka served me some vegetarian food… There was bread and butter too… I polished those off as well and went down to bathe

When I went down, it was a bathroom with a big bathtub.. A jacuzzi, apparently.. Normally I don't even know how to mix hot and cold water.. I bathe in whatever heat the last person left… And this had four or five taps as well… I somehow worked out what they all were and bathed.. Only the jacuzzi I couldn't work out how to use.. When I came out and asked, Mithra said it only comes on once the tub is filled to a certain level… Having heard all this, Sing Keeth went after me.. He bathed a long time, and when he came out the bathroom was full of water… Seeing the circus he'd made, Thushara gave him a real scolding… But copping all this is nothing new for him

The cluster of islands we went through on the ship was very beautiful.. Imagine little Pillaiyars shaped by hand set here and there as mountains in a sea with no waves at all..? That's what the place is like.. Next Tom said we had to go kayaking and moved everyone into small boats.. Thushara said she wasn't coming… The four of us went.. Dhanush and I in one canoe.. Sing Keeth and Mithra in another

We had to sit one in front of the other and paddle, like rowing a boat..Water splashes everywhere behind.. But it was lovely to do it on the sea… But past a certain point it's deep sea .. They sent us off telling us not to go there… I thought our monkeys would go there first to gawk… As I thought, everyone went and stood in that spot watching the cargo ships…

There was a village in there too.. He said don't go close to them… the guard dogs will bark and leap at you.. I'm scared of dogs as it is… I didn't let the canoe go anywhere near.. While we were going along nicely in our canoe, Sing Keeth, like a monkey from nowhere, came, splashed water on us and went..The chicken with me was even more scared.. Saying he had to get him back, he paddled our canoe fast too, rammed into his, and the two of them started splashing water at each other by turns

Caught in this, not only did I get completely soaked, at one point the canoe nearly capsized as well… Even when I shouted and scolded, they ignored me and played on, and I was furious… When I let fly at them with the filthiest swear words, all three were shocked.. So was I… I never swore even at school.. Words I've heard a lot lately came out from somewhere.. To this day they say it was a big deal.. I said it when my life was in danger… Enough that at least they behaved properly once I'd said it..

Because of this circus we were the last..As soon as we came, they took us along too and showed us how pearls are taken from oysters… You'd have to sell everything we own to buy them.. Terribly expensive… There, like doctors, they cut open the oyster and put a bead inside for a pearl to form..It was pitiful to watch…
After that we went back to the ship
note: A Pillaiyar shaped by hand is a small lump of turmeric or clay pinched into the form of Ganesha for worship. "Akka" means elder sister, a polite way to address a woman.
